entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. For technical support, press two. To speak with a representative, press zero or stay on the line.
Zero. Ugh, just get me a person.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, you're speaking with Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for the VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's just not working for me.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, hold on... it's VF98765. I got it about two weeks ago.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered 15 days ago. No problem at all, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, 90 days? That's great! I was worried I was running out of time. Perfect. So you'll send me a label?
Actually... I am so sorry, I need to correct myself. I was looking at the policy for our stationary bikes. For accessories like the VeloBand, the return window is 30 days from delivery.
Wait, what did you just say? A second ago it was 90 days. Now it's 30?
Yes, and I sincerely apologize for misspeaking. The correct policy for this item is 30 days. You still have 15 days left to make the return.
No. No, no, no. You **promised me** 90 days. I heard you say it. This is a **recorded line**, isn't it?
Yes, all our calls are recorded for quality and training purposes.
Good. Then you can play it back and hear what you told me. This feels like a **bait and switch**. You tell me the good news, then yank it away? That's a horrible way to do business.
Sir, I completely understand your frustration, and that was 100% my error. I provided you with incorrect information, and I deeply apologize for the confusion.
So what are you going to do about it? Because **you just said** I had three months. I was going to try it for another week, but now you're telling me I can't.

You are absolutely right, sir. It was my mistake. Please hold for one moment... Okay. I've spoken with my supervisor. Because I gave you incorrect information, we are going to honor it. I am placing a note on your account right now, extending your return window to the 90 days I originally stated.
You're... you're serious? You'll actually honor the 90 days?

Yes, absolutely. It was our mistake, and we want to make it right. I'm generating your pre-paid return label now and emailing it to you. You can use it anytime in the next 75 days. The email will also confirm the 90-day window in writing.
Wow. Okay. Thank you. I was ready for a fight, I really appreciate you doing that.
It's my pleasure, and again, my apologies for the mix-up. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Sarah. You really helped me out.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
